purpose: Restore the closer pectoral fin raised over the near eye.

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the selected transparent shark sprite to edit. Image 2 is the exact original SLEVEJM2 010 pose and is the authority for the fin-over-eye action. Image 3 is the established gray-shark identity and style reference only. Repose the CLOSER, viewer-facing pectoral fin on screen-left: it rises from the near shoulder/body side and bends upward in front of the face, with the fin held OVER AND COVERING the near eye as in Image 2. The tall pale/gray shape beside the head in Image 2 is this raised pectoral fin, not a second eye, horn or forehead spike. Occlude the near eye naturally behind the raised fin. Keep only the small far-side eye peeking from behind if visible in the exact original angle. Preserve the wide open razor-toothed mouth, tongue, upward head angle, broad ivory belly, screen-right pectoral fin, dorsal fin, torso, waterline, colors, bold ink and cel shading. Exactly two pectoral fins total; do not add hands, fingers, horns or extra limbs. Preserve clear margins and genuine transparent RGBA. No background, checkerboard, glow, shadow or text.
